Digital Public Infrastructure in Africa: Procurement, Interoperability and Accountable Service Delivery

Digital public infrastructure can shorten the distance between a person and a public service. It can also concentrate failure, exclusion and supplier dependence inside systems that become difficult to replace. As African governments move from pilots to national and cross-border platforms, the central question is no longer whether to digitise. It is how to procure a modular, governed service that people can use, challenge and trust.
